messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — customer 78321 reported their invoice total is ~2.3k higher than the dashboard for Feb month-end. Invoice 2026-02-INV-78321 shows an extra line item labeled "service: burst-pack" for 240K tokens. Dashboard shows no matching line.
Sam Ortiz: Can you paste the invoice line JSON or a screenshot? also cc @Alex Patel.
Maya Chen: Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/screens/78321/inv-2026-02 (redacted). Line in invoice: `{"code":"burst-pack","units":240000,"unit_price":0.01}`. Dashboard API /billing/usage for that account returns totals ~18K tokens for Feb.
BillingBot: Automated alert: month_end_recon mismatch for account=78321, delta_tokens=221000, delta_amount=2230.00. rule=invoice_vs_dashboard_ratio.
Alex Patel: Thanks — curious if this is a late ingest/duplicate or a plan-tier rewrite. Two quick checks: 1) metering-aggregator run logs around cutoff (UTC 2026-03-01T00:10Z). 2) check meter_events table for duplicate insertions with same event_id.
Nina Park: SQL I ran locally (limited to last 7 days):
```
select event_id, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens_sum
from meter_events
where account_id = 78321 and created_at >= '2026-02-01' and created_at < '2026-03-01'
group by event_id
having cnt > 1
order by tokens_sum desc
limit 20;
```
Nina Park: result: one event_id `evt_1a9c` appears twice, tokens_sum=240000, cnt=2.
Sam Ortiz: ok that's suspicious. Was there a retry/backfill? any manual imports?
Maya Chen: No manual imports for this customer. They do have a Dedicated contract but on hosted billing.
Alex Patel: If evt_1a9c duplicated that's likely why invoice has a ghost burst-pack. We need to see the original ingestion source: `metering-ingest` vs `bursting-service`. Check `source_app` column.
Nina Park: Query:
```
select event_id, source_app, created_by, created_at, tokens
from meter_events
where event_id = 'evt_1a9c';
```
Nina Park: returns two rows: one source_app='metering-ingest', created_at=2026-02-28T23:59:55Z, tokens=0 (meta row), second source_app='bursting-service', created_at=2026-03-01T00:00:03Z, tokens=240000.
Ryan Liu: aha — there's a cutoff boundary. The metering-aggregator runs at 00:00:00Z and we have a backfill job that ran at 00:00:02Z that accidentally re-emitted a full-day aggregate. Looks like the backfill was non-idempotent.
Sam Ortiz: @Ryan can you point to the job id and logs? we need run_id and if duplicate event_id was generated by backfill.
Ryan Liu: run id `meter-agg-20260301-07` (k8s job). In the logs I see backfill step `emit-agg` retried once due to a transient DB timeout and on retry didn't check for existing event_id -> created duplicate. snippet: `ERROR: timeout while writing agg; RETRYING` then `INFO: emit-agg success event_id=evt_1a9c tokens=240000`.
Alex Patel: Thanks. Root cause = non-idempotent backfill retry crossing the cutoff window. We should: 1) patch the backfill to upsert on event_id. 2) add a uniqueness constraint on meter_events(event_id). 3) run a one-off cleanup for affected accounts.
Maya Chen: For customer-facing next steps — they want a fix and refund. Recommended temporary workaround?
Sam Ortiz: Manual adjustment: create a negative invoice line referencing the duplicated event_id with amount -2400.00 and mark for audit. I'll draft the credit note.
Nina Park: I've prepared a query to list all accounts affected by duplicates in Feb:
```
select account_id, sum(tokens) as duplicate_tokens, count(distinct event_id) as dup_events
from (
  select account_id, event_id, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens
  from meter_events
  where created_at >= '2026-02-01' and created_at < '2026-03-01'
  group by account_id, event_id
) t
where cnt > 1
group by account_id
order by duplicate_tokens desc
limit 100;
```
Nina Park: That query returns 6 accounts with duplicate tokens > 50k. I flagged them to finance.
Sam Ortiz: Good. @BillingBot can you attach invoice 2026-02-INV-78321 to support ticket #SUP-1289 and mark as under review?
BillingBot: Done. Ticket=SUP-1289, attachments=[inv-2026-02-INV-78321], label=under_review.
Alex Patel: Engineering action items: (a) hotfix backfill to use upsert, (b) add DB unique index on event_id, (c) run cleanup script to delete duplicate meter_events and re-run aggregator for affected accounts (patch + backfill run id `meter-agg-cleanup-20260302`).
Ryan Liu: I'll own (a) and (c). ETA for hotfix and cleanup run: EOD 2026-03-02.
Sam Ortiz: I'll prepare customer comms + provisional credit and coordinate with finance for refunds.
Maya Chen: Thanks all. I'll update the customer and close loop once refund posted. :white_check_mark:
Alex Patel: Postmortem note: root cause = non-idempotent backfill retry crossing UTC cutoff -> duplicate high-value aggregate event. Preventable via upsert + index + preflight check.
Nina Park: Adding to incident tracker INC-2026-044.
Maya Chen: tagging this thread for month-end recon doc. action items assigned to Ryan & Sam.
Sam Ortiz: closing loop here, please ping if anything blocks the cleanup. :pray:
